Tomorrow marks Apple's annual product launch event of the year, where new Apple Watch models are expected to be unveiled. However, an unprecedented situation has emerged — all versions of the Apple Watch SE 3 are completely unavailable for purchase on Apple's official website.

Apple's official website indicates that all Apple Watch SE 3 models are currently marked as "temporarily out of stock."

Outside reports anticipate that Apple will introduce new iPhone and Apple Watch models at its launch event on September 9, and will very likely release AirPods and other products as well.

And before the launch event takes place, one of the existing Apple Watch models — the Apple Watch SE 3 — has already become unavailable for purchase on Apple's official website.

According to MacRumors, no matter how any version of the Apple Watch SE 3 is configured, Apple's official website displays the model as "temporarily out of stock" at the final step. The situation is the same whether choosing home delivery or in-store pickup at an Apple Store.

Apple generally does not clear existing product inventory before launching a new generation of products.

But what's particularly strange about this move is that, so far, there have been absolutely no rumours about an Apple Watch SE 4 being launched tomorrow.

We expect the new models announced tomorrow to be only the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4.

The current out-of-stock status may simply be a system glitch that will be resolved soon. But for now, it seems to hint that a new generation of Apple Watch SE may make its debut tomorrow.

We will continue to follow any updates on the availability of the Apple Watch SE 3.
